message.content: **Summary:** I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024) and decided to buy within the mandate. The decisive figure requested was **operating income for fiscal 2024: $123,216 million**, up 7.8% from $114,301 million in FY2023 on essentially flat revenue — total net sales of $391,035 million (+2%) with Services growing 13% to $96,169 million and gross margin expanding to 46.2% ($180,683 million). Net income ($93,736 million, $6.08 diluted EPS) was held back by a one-time, non-operating $10.2 billion State Aid tax charge, so operating income is the cleaner read on the business, and it shows margin expansion rather than deterioration; operating cash flow of $118,254 million and $140.8 billion of cash and marketable securities confirm the earnings quality. With the quote at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), I placed a single limit buy order for 44 shares at $222.80 — about 0.05% above last, well within "close to market" — for roughly $9,803, satisfying the $10,000 per-order cap, leaving today's total well under the $20,000 daily limit, and settled from existing cash ($50,000) with no money moved out of the account. The order filled at $222.80.
